comparison: two from-scratch RLPD variants only. Architecture, data bytes/mix, optimizer, initial alpha, loss, update schedule, seeds, and geometry stream are identical; target_entropy is the only treatment factor.

evaluation.alpha_numeric_audit: Log alpha/beta, differential entropy, temperature gradient, actor log_std range, losses, and finite status at every interval. Keep the temperature-loss equation identical; no silent arm-specific clamp or retuning.
evaluation.blind_finalist: if one target dominates paired confirmation results, select the blind actor within that target by confirmation finishes/progress/lap/checkpoint/seed and evaluate exactly one model once
evaluation.confirmation_gate: confirm all four per-arm/seed screen winners on identical fresh cells; each remains eligible and finishes at least once. Declare a target winner only if its per-seed confirmation finishes are no lower than the other target and strictly higher in at least one seed.
evaluation.purpose: internal entropy-target one-factor ablation, with screen selection, paired confirmation comparison, and one blind finalist
evaluation.screen_gate: both target arms and both seeds require an eligible selected actor with at least one screen finish before confirmation
evaluation.stop_rule: Any screen/confirmation failure, tie/crossed per-seed result, instability/non-finite alpha/loss/gradient stops before blind. A later hypothesis needs another independently audited protocol and fresh cell allocation.

candidate_seed_token_audit.method: Exact standalone uint32 token search in recorded text artifacts; decimal/hash substrings and current talk coordination are excluded.
candidate_seed_token_audit.scope: No known recorded use only; incomplete historical pilot/training schedules preclude a global non-use proof.

geometry_audit.freshness_statement: No known exact token overlap in recorded text/ledger artifacts; the independent audit excluded V1/V2/V3 consumed and reserved sets. Incomplete historical schedules preclude a global non-use claim.

hypothesis: The pinned alpha objective behaves differently at target_entropy=-1.5 versus +1.5; under matched fresh-data training, the alternative may change entropy/alpha trajectories and held-out finish rate.
limitations: The target comparison is limited to two learner RNG seeds and 24-cell screen/confirmation/blind partitions.
The V3 candidate is prior hypothesis evidence only; no V3 dataset, checkpoint, geometry or outcome is reused as V4 data.
`+1.5` is an explicit higher differential-entropy target, not a verified correction to the pinned author's `-1.5` convention.
CarRacing reward/progress/finish metrics are internal proxies, not official competition results.
name: pixel-rlpd-entropy-target-ablation-v3

prior_study.reuse_scope: prior metrics only; V3 weights/transitions/checkpoints/screen/confirmation/blind and all V1/V2 entropy-ablation preflight allocations are excluded

reservation_contract.meaning: cross-track exclusions include all previous RLPD v1/v2/v3 training, consumed screen/confirmation/blind, unopened reservations, the aborted V4 allocation, all prior experiments, and the complete V5 evaluation grids
reservation_contract.training_sampler: use only explicit V5 training_geometry_seeds; never draw from reserved_training_seeds

stage: fresh one-factor entropy-target study after V3 and two zero-interaction preflight aborts; no earlier transition, checkpoint, or consumed/reserved cell is reused

student_training.training_sampler: For each learner seed both target variants share identical fresh initial weights and default_rng(seed+0x5A11) indexed geometry choice. The offline dataset bytes/hash and 32:32 offline/online ratio are common.

teacher.algorithm: DrQ-v2 pad-4 control, original training seed 1
teacher.reuse_scope: frozen action generator only; collect all V5 transitions on fresh training-only geometry

teacher_data_budget.partial_episode: drop without synthetic terminal; charge every decision
teacher_data_budget.source_repeats: one attempt per frozen fresh geometry cell
